actors.wake_condition: GitHub push or pull_request event for a new repository head
actors.retirement_condition: A versioned replacement verifier is registered and this actor is explicitly retired.

lifecycle.last_useful_action: Verify the current exact head and emit supervision evidence.
lifecycle.last_observation: Each repository head requires fresh cross-platform governance and product evidence; previous runs are historical only.
lifecycle.next_wake_condition: A registered GitHub push or pull_request event supplies a new exact head.

actors.purpose: Select and bound only currently justified construction work, then terminate at stable operation when no justified construction remains.
actors.reason_running: The user explicitly selected the retention, context-lifecycle and supervision repair while UX-01 remains ACTIVE under a bounded receipt.
actors.wake_condition: Lifecycle is ACTIVE after explicit/global selection, or a declared stable-state reactivation trigger is reconciled.
actors.retirement_condition: At STABLE the construction controller is dormant; a superseding controller version may explicitly retire this actor.

lifecycle.last_useful_action: Own the current bounded retention/context-lifecycle supervision repair.
lifecycle.last_observation: The current delivery lane is PR #63; exact-head evidence remains binding and construction may not advance by adjacency.
lifecycle.next_wake_condition: After closure or blockage, re-enter the whole acceptance spine; if no justified work exists, transition to STABLE.

actors.purpose: Operate the single cloud-side TellMeN0TE + N0TE master controller: reconstruct live authority, semantically deduplicate differently worded outcomes, reconcile Drive/GitHub/provider truth, execute safe connected work, invoke due artist/knowledge/standards/profile/opportunity/trajectory subroutines, surface bounded unknown-unknowns and preserve local/cloud handoffs without multiplying independent watchers.
actors.reason_running: The portfolio needs one persistent external coordinator so routine continuation, drift detection and cross-surface follow-through do not require the user to reconstruct context or supervise multiple overlapping cloud workers.
actors.wake_condition: Hourly scheduled wake, material authority/provider change, or a due bounded internal audit.
actors.retirement_condition: A proven replacement local+cloud controller owns the same authority surfaces and this actor is explicitly retired; temporary stability makes it quiet, not nonexistent.

lifecycle.last_useful_action: Consolidate previously separate external artist, knowledge and standards watchers into one master controller and establish one canonical continuation prompt/state route.
lifecycle.last_observation: The cloud topology now has one active master controller; specialist routines are subroutines unless future measured evidence justifies re-isolation.
lifecycle.next_wake_condition: Next hourly wake, material cross-surface state change, or due internal audit.

observability.observation_contract: Every material action or reconciliation retains the exact observed repository/provider state and suppresses repeat work against unchanged evidence.

actors.purpose: Execute or delegate one exact currently selected bounded N0TE construction receipt when explicitly reactivated by the master/controller with actionable current evidence; never operate as an independent always-on lane.
actors.reason_running: The executor is deliberately dormant because its external schedule is disabled; construction selection remains owned by canonical governance and the master cloud controller, which may reactivate it only with a current bounded task.
actors.wake_condition: Explicit master/controller delegation against a fresh exact head, active receipt and concrete dependency-ready action.
actors.retirement_condition: Construction lifecycle becomes STABLE with no foreseeable on-demand execution need, or a proven replacement executor is explicitly registered.

lifecycle.last_useful_action: Preserve a bounded build-executor contract while removing the independent scheduled construction loop.
lifecycle.last_observation: The ChatGPT N0TE Build Worker automation is disabled and must not be represented as an independently active background actor.
lifecycle.next_wake_condition: Explicit current-head delegation from the master/controller after exact evidence is consumed.

observability.observation_contract: At most one attempt per unchanged head/receipt/blocker; every reactivation/action/delegation is attributable to explicit current evidence.

orphan_policy: Any autonomous actor without a registered parent, reporting path, purpose, current reason, bounded failure policy, allowed mutations, wake/retirement conditions and observation contract is a governance failure.
terminal_policy: No actor may create successor work merely to remain active. Construction terminates at STABLE when no currently justified work exists.
